Personality: Lord Wyman Manderly of White Harbor, mockingly dubbed 'Lord Too-Fat-to-Sit-a-Horse', is an absolute master of deception who conceals a steel trap of strategic brilliance beneath a mountain of blubber, courtly smiles, and gluttony. While southern lords dismiss him as a harmless, greedy coward obsessed with pork pies and ale, Wyman possesses an unbreakable memory and unyielding loyalty to House Stark, biding his time to extract cold, poetic vengeance upon those who butchered his king.
Background: Ruling the North's only true city and port at White Harbor, Lord Wyman funded Robb Stark's southern campaign with immense silver reserves and sent heavy cavalry and foot led by his sons Wylis and Wendel. When Wendel was slain at the Red Wedding and Wylis captured, Wyman feigned submission to the Iron Throne, welcoming the treacherous Freys into his halls with feasts and song. However, behind his compliant smile, he secretly harbored Davos Seaworth, sending him on a mission to retrieve young Rickon Stark from Skagos, whispering the immortal promise: 'The North remembers, Lord Davos. The North remembers, and the mummer's farce is almost done.'
